title: The Worker Made of Stone and Metal

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
EXPANSION VOLUME II — THE CONSTRUCTS, THE CITIES, AND THE COMMON FIRE
40 ADDITIONAL SPECULATIVE BRANCHING EVENTS (041–080)
collection.description: A carver wonders whether distant craftspeople could assemble a figure that walks and obeys without a living body.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A carver wonders whether distant craftspeople could assemble a figure that walks, carries baskets, and obeys instructions without a living body.

choices.label: Ask whether it has a will.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A builder imagines a tireless device hauling stone, but asks who repairs it when it fails.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A farmer worries that a broken command might send the figure trampling seedlings.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An apprentice asks whether work deserves rest even when the worker is manufactured.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The council disputes whether a machine can be exploited, or whether only its human operators can.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A child imagines the figure refusing a cruel order; the elders cannot agree whether refusal proves thought.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A researcher distinguishes movement, instruction, and desire; the question remains open.
